CLI.default: JSON/hash/source metadata only; no NPZ decode or contact-regime computation; no output writes
CLI.run_authority: Only an explicit Root invocation with --run and a fresh output authorizes one saved-data computation. This source-only protocol is not a self-authorization or a run config.

scope.question: Describe every recorded branch solver-PRE generated-contact regime alongside all previously saved finite-control/encoded-state response descriptors; no selection by response, contact, force or prior stability.
scope.selection: Read the original physical_samples JSONL; branch_id is not None is the sole primary sample selection. Retain all 152*4 rows, including zero-contact, numerical-zero-control and encoded-flat rows. No old stable9 or error-based filter.

provenance.pin_equality: SHA256 plus Path.samefile for identity; slash spelling is not an identity test. Never mutate recorded parent pins.
provenance.source_closure: Consumer current source/checker/CLI and executed focused proof must be bound at run time. Reuse parent source maps, retaining every unique actual file, canonicalized by resolved filesystem identity plus SHA; do not merge distinct physical copies by SHA.
required_joins: physical saved1762 -> same config/producer_report/run_dir/input bundle and original branch/snapshot files
dense saved35 -> same config/producer_report/run_dir; geometry_catalog must be its immutable output-pinned complete catalog
response saved22 -> same config/report/run_dir; raw152/metadata152/decomposition/pairs64/guard_summary must be its immutable output-pinned artifacts
response original physical config/report/branch/snapshot provenance must be the same full05 physical run
response saved22 source visible58/control guards remain passed; no new repair or selected passing subset

native_catalog.identity_spaces: Use native geom IDs/native body IDs. FK-local body indices, mocap IDs and raw contact type bits are different spaces. native_geom_catalog.type is a geom enum, not ContactType. No new MJB needed.

primary_categories.hand_self: both ordered geoms are enabled hand (after HO precedence)

secondary_descriptors.object_nonhand: has_object AND NOT has_enabled_hand; do not rename the unknown nonhand counterpart static environment
secondary_descriptors.hand_other: has_enabled_hand AND NOT has_object AND NOT both_hand
secondary_descriptors.both_object: both geoms belong to the object; preserve if present

native_catalog.all_pairs: No force/depth/contact-type prefilter, no pair deduplication; preserve original ordered geom pair and original contact index.

saved_sample_ABI.identity: Unique (branch_id,substep), branch_id 0..151 and substep 1..4. Join original branch_index, snapshot_records, response_metadata152 by exact branch ID/path/k/type; physical sample phase is k. Preserve raw file line index. Expected baseline=96 PRE rows and direction=512 PRE rows; all8 snapshots each76 PRE rows.
saved_sample_ABI.phase: Solver quantities and object_solver_COM/pose are the just-completed substep solver PRE integration state, canonical_pre_tick=4*k+substep-1. pre_time/pre_qpos/pre_qvel precede the 5ms integration. post_time/post_qpos/post_qvel are post integration. Do not mix stored contact force/COM with post20ms reward state or convert a new state.
saved_sample_ABI.last_interval: k149 branch substeps precede terminal obs150. Retain them; no u150/extra decision or bootstrap claim.
saved_sample_ABI.parser_guards: nacon/nefc are nonnegative strict integers; contacts/raw arrays have matching counts and original geom order; geom IDs belong to complete catalog; numeric fields finite and exact required shapes. Empty JSON [] may become an empty array only when nacon==0. No truncated/unknown row may be silently represented as empty. Raw slot width is saved, not inferred as a fixed contact dimension.

geometry_statistics.primary: Compute only from the original saved generated contact dist. Per all/HO/HH/other/object_nonhand/hand_other: count; min_generated_dist=min(dist) or null when absent; observed_candidate_depth=max(0,-dist) over generated rows, or 0 only for a valid empty set. Preserve absent mask.
geometry_statistics.clearance: global_clearance=UNKNOWN on every sample/category, including empty and positive-dist candidates. Not minimum separation over ungenerated pairs.
geometry_statistics.threshold: The inherited 3mm descriptor, if reported, is strict observed_candidate_depth_m>0.003; it does not select rows or confer global geometry/force feasibility.
geometry_statistics.source_fields: Carry original measured_hand_object.penetration_m, penetration_by_category_m and object_environment_contacts as named source evidence. The original penetration_m is all-category, not HO-only.

force_evidence.primary_source: Retain original decoded contacts[ci].force6; do not call mj_contactForce again, reconstruct pyramid coefficients, infer friction/condim for all contacts, or recompute world force/COM torque.
force_evidence.raw_slot_rule: Original per-contact integer 1-D slot vector; -1 padding is allowed, all other entries must satisfy 0<=slot<nefc, and at least one nonnegative slot is required for force evidence. No fixed slot count, continuity, or pyramid re-decode assumption.
force_evidence.secondary_force_eligible: (raw_type & 1)!=0 AND raw_worldid==0 AND host_efc_address>=0 AND raw_slots have >=1 nonnegative entry AND every nonpadding raw slot is in [0,nefc) AND original force6 is finite.
force_evidence.secondary_positive_force: force_eligible AND original force6[0]>1e-6 N (strict). The normal compression component has units N; tangential force components N and local torque components Nm.
force_evidence.unknowns: Retain sensor-only, all -1, out-of-range and other force-ineligible generated contacts with independent reason flags. Their decoded zero is not evidence of true zero force. The positive-force subset does not replace primary generated geometry.
force_evidence.host_vs_raw: Host efc_address has been reordered by get_data_into. Never use it to index raw_efc_force/type. Keep original raw WP slots/type/worldid and host address separately; no all-contact force re-decode qualification.
force_evidence.source_helper_active: Retain original measured_hand_object.active for HO in original HO order; it used only host address>=0 and Fn>1e-6, and is not equivalent to the new raw-slot-qualified secondary descriptor.
force_evidence.no_new_wrench: Copy stored hand_object_force_on_object_w_N, hand_object_moment_about_COM_w_Nm, direct_torque_included_once, object_solver_COM/pose unchanged at sample level. Do not sum decoded components into a new world wrench or recompute r cross F/direct torque.

response_join.authority: All original response raw152/metadata152/decomposition/pairs64, not any author-selected interpretation subset. Join each branch once and each PRE sample to its branch; preserve all128 endpoints and64 pairs.
response_join.branch_order: snapshot_id*19+offset, offsets0..2 baseline repeats; offsets3..18 preserve original epsilon/j/sign branch order and metadata.
response_join.zero_control: actual_delta_u20_rad_F64 = plus actual_u_FP32 cast F64 minus minus actual_u_FP32 cast F64. Record coordinate-zero/all20-zero numeric flags, all20 raw bit-equality, and optional absolute-control-zero flag separately. Zero change is not absolute zero action.
response_join.encoded_flat: Use original FP32 target and prediction endpoints. Record per-feature (plusF64-minusF64)==0 and raw bit-equality independently; p indices40:43 (m), R43:52 raw dimensionless elements. Block all-numeric-zero/all-bit-equal flags never imply physical insensitivity/true derivative or rotate/project R.
response_join.existing_decomposition: Carry saved centered_model/physical_response_F64, actual coordinate denominator, undefined mask, legacy clipping/d_eff/center_offset/asymmetry as already proven source descriptors; do not recompute EMA/C2 or reinterpret legacy dimensionless d_eff as radians.
response_join.no_selection: Do not subset contacts, branches, snapshots or endpoints by zero-control, encoded-flat, Fn, regime, old stable9 or observed error. No new stable/accuracy/noise threshold, causal or gradient certificate.

tables.sample608: One record per original branch PRE, including empty; identity/phase/raw counts/categories/source wrench/COM/pose and source measured_hand_object retained. JSON and CSV.
tables.contact_long: Every generated contact in original sample/contact-index order, ordered native IDs/names/body IDs/category/flags/dist/depth/pos/frame/original force6/raw type/world/slots/host address/force reasons. JSONL and CSV. Total length data-dependent, no guessed count.
tables.branch152: All four PRE rows per original branch with mechanical original branch identity/response descriptors; do not invent a persistent-contact track.
tables.snapshot8: All19 branches per exact label, completeness plus separate category descriptions, no outcome-selected subset.
tables.response_pairs64: All64 epsilon pairs with original endpoint IDs/actual-delta/numeric and bitwise encoded-flat descriptors; include pointers to all8 paired PRE records. No stable filter.

outputs.provenance: Protocol snapshot, current consumer/CLI/checker and focused CPU proof/READY pins, canonical unique-source inventory/archive, immutable input/output pins, before/after input/source hash evidence; compact console, full records to files.

failure_policy: Hash/identity/provenance/shape/finite/count/order/branch-response join failures block the whole analysis, preserve available source/raw/guard/error evidence and do not repair, skip a row or analyze only passing snapshots. A well-formed but force-ineligible contact remains in primary data with explicit reasons; do not silently convert its force to a qualified zero. Fresh output/no overwrite, no retry or fallback.

pre_execution_scope.work_this_protocol_creation: Source and JSON/hash metadata reads only; no primary contact table/NPZ decode/response computation performed. Independent7 fixture proof is synthetic only.
pre_execution_scope.focused_future_CPU_contract: Only new saved parser/bitflag/raw-slot/valid-empty/phase/response-join fixtures; reuse parent1762/35/22 source proofs. No actual whole608 computation or model/native backend during readiness.
